newsitem.title: INDIA: Yield on Indian 364-day t-bill unchanged at 9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yield on Indian 364-day t-bill unchanged at 9 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Wednesday it set a cut-off price of 91.76 rupees at the fortnightly auction of 364-day t-bills, unchanged from the previous auction.
The yield remained steady at nine percent, dealers said.
The RBI said it had received 13 bids amounting to 3.2 billion rupees. It had accepted one bid for one billion rupees, at a weighted average price of 91.76 rupees, the central bank added.
